However, sam_fill_rate fell from 0.7298 to 0.7229 and depth_nan_ratio rose from 0.2091 to 0.2106. proposal.failure_mode: Stage-2 radial gate likely remains slightly too tight at the outer radius, contributing to stage-3 depth holes and stage-5 under-coverage; confidence is moderate because Round 1 changed parameters jointly.
